problem_context.problem_statement: Rewrite and verify CircularAreaInit against the approved unified idmanager-style circular_area_state/store_circular_area abstraction. Public spec must expose no implementation-level With or exists values.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For requested length in [4,256], failure returns NULL with emp; success returns store_circular_area(CircularAreaInitState(requested), retval), whose capacity is floor(requested/4)*4 and FIFO contents are nil.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Require 4 <= circular_area_length <= 256 and emp. Ensure (__return == 0 and emp) or (__return != 0 and store_circular_area(CircularAreaInitState(circular_area_length), __return)).
spec_hint: Use exactly the shared circular_area_state and store_circular_area. Internal assertions/call specs may expose allocator and descriptor fields only as symbolic-execution bridges. The public function spec must have no data_buffer/aligned/physical/readidx/writeidx/status/operations binders.
preferred_hidden_properties: CircularAreaInitState deterministically captures aligned capacity and empty FIFO; store_circular_area existentially hides physical ring representation and mixed_full.
forbidden_patterns: Do not use CircularAreaBackingResource or recreate a flat descriptor predicate. Do not expose physical, indices, status, data pointer, or operations pointer in the public function spec. Do not use QCP_demos_human.
reference_case_hints: crtosverify/lib/idnode.v store_idmanager style; existing completed Init proof may be used only as a stale proof-pattern reference.
